recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If current v2-0131 deprecated-code expansion behavior still needs correction, pursue it through the active THO/UTG path represented by FHIR-32232 or a UP ticket rather than changing core FHIR source for this already-applied STU3 issue.
issue_request: FHIR-14118 is Published/Persuasive. It asked why FHIR's v2 table 0131 value set included codes deprecated in v2.3 and requested either active-only imports or an explicit statement that the displayed v2 table codes were intentionally available for FHIR use. The accepted Vocab resolution was to make FHIR's v2 table code system/value set rendering version-specific and consistent with the declared v2 table version.
initial_application: Git commit a89dad7cf7d547ea0084aaf17d9ebb7033be58f6 applied the issue as GF#14118/svn revision 13458 by adding a generated v2 table expansion include to source/v2/template-tbl.html and updating v2 import tooling and expansion cache content. No current source location appears to have missed that original application.
additional_context: Git commit 5c0494aacfd0b8bd52bc72c587aa89d0a64246f8 later removed UTG content from core, and the latest combined source has no source/v2 directory. Current core still references the external THO code system http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/v2-0131 in examples and resource-local value sets, but Patient.contact.role now binds to relatedperson-relationshiptype, Patient Contact Relationship is retired/deprecated, and relatedperson-relationshiptype explicitly enumerates only v2-0131 E, O, and U. Later Jira records FHIR-32232 and FHIR-39206 identify a remaining deprecated-code display/expansion concern as THO/UTG terminology metadata work, but FHIR-32232 is Triaged and FHIR-39206 is Duplicate rather than an applied core decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The applied FHIR-14118 source change belonged to the former core v2 table renderer, which is no longer in current core build scope, so changing core source now would either duplicate resolved historical work or preempt unresolved THO/UTG work.
